posts.text: Nothing like getting the call that your son’s 2012 Tahoe with 350,000 miles is broken down in a parking lot unable to get in gear - only to identify the problem, buy the $12 bushing & fix it in 90 mins… But corporate America keeps building things more expensive & harder to fix!
posts.summary: Criticizes corporate manufacturing complexity and cost over repairability

posts.text:
Most Americans want to live free, safe, and secure, and to know that if they work hard they can get ahead.

It’s fair to ask why Congress doesn’t live by the same standard. Families have to make tough choices. We should too.

Fiscal responsibility isn’t just good economics, it’s a prerequisite for preserving the American Dream.
posts.summary: Demands Congress adopt fiscal responsibility like families do
